title: Skinwalker Ranch cattle mutilations and Bigelow experiments

tellings.quote: and the family that used to live on the land would see tons of cattle mutilations they'd experience all sorts of paranormal things bigelow buys it bigelow is obviously very interested in the you know uap phenomena and now it seems like it's this place where they do all sorts of experiments they have anomalous electromagnetic effects on the grounds

plain: Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah, is said to be a place where the family who once lived there saw many mutilated cattle and all kinds of other strange events. Then Robert Bigelow, a businessman deeply interested in UFOs, bought it in the 1990s, and Michels says it became a site for experiments where odd electromagnetic effects show up on the ground. Michels tells this himself on a 2022 episode where the mathematician Eric Weinstein debates the physicist Hal Puthoff.
